csv_scope_of_work: Jefferson County is seeking an architectural firm or individual architect to provide architectural and design services for its Community Development Block Grant Disaster Recovery (CDBG-DR) application. The award of the architectural contract for this project is contingent upon the grant being funded by the Georgia Department of Community Affairs. Responding firms should be technically qualified and licensed to provide the design and inspection services for local state and federally funded projects including architectural services and programs.
